description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001-File No. 16/0102-Homagama
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in Homagama, Colombo District. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title registration, and property rights without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
